-- TX-38 (R): Jon Bonck wins R runoff over Shelly deZevallos; faces Democrat Melissa McDonough
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Melissa McDonough',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Jon Bonck',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat. Jon Bonck (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Shelly deZevallos (65.4% vs 34.6%). Faces Democrat Melissa McDonough in November. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 38;

-- TX-37: Greg Casar (D) is incumbent — R primary runoff was Lauren Peña vs Ge''Nell Gary
-- Per NYT data: TX-37 R runoff had Lauren Peña winning (L. Pena 58.4% vs G. Gary 41.6%)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Greg Casar',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Lauren Peña',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Greg Casar (D) is the incumbent (moved from old TX-35 after redistricting). Lauren Peña (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Ge''Nell Gary (58.4% vs 41.6%). Rated Solid D.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 37;
